$description: Zapper design system tokens (W3C DTCG format). Values in dp/sp map 1:1 to Jetpack Compose. Source of truth: regenerate Compose files from this file.

color.$description: Material 3 color roles generated with material-color-utilities (SchemeVibrant; SchemeMonochrome for graphite). Default theme = indigo. On Android 12+ dynamic color replaces these unless the user picks a seed.

stateLayer.$description: Opacity of onX color drawn over a container for interaction states (M3).

typography.$description: Roboto Flex (OFL, Google Fonts downloadable font), FontFamily.Default fallback. Key labels use tabular figures (tnum).

shape.$description: Corner radii. Remote keys use keyRounded by default; user can switch key style.

squircle.$description: Use a continuous-corner (superellipse) shape; 30% approximates it.

layout.$description: Remote canvas grid. cellSize = (screenWidth - 2*margin - (columns-1)*gutter) / columns, clamped to [minCell,maxCell].

motion.$description: M3 Expressive spring tokens (Compose spring(dampingRatio, stiffness)). Durations are fallbacks for non-spring animations.

haptics.$description: Semantic haptic events -> android.view.HapticFeedbackConstants. User setting: off | light | strong (strong adds Vibrator primitives on API 31+).
